items.title: Carolyn Buck Interview, 1969-03-25
items.q: I took him to the graveside and put flowers on Jeannette's grave, his wife's grave

ctx.x: Did he know, did he choose the place where he was going to be buried?

Yes. He had, when we went on All Saints, All Souls Day, I took him to the graveside and put flowers on Jeannette's grave, his wife's grave, late wife's grave, and on his mother's grave. They were both buried in the same place. And he said, this is where I'm going to be. Not here. He didn't say to me many times, I want to stop there and say some prayers. And he always said, it won't be long now before you'll be coming here. He said, because I'm going to be out here very shortly and you'll be coming to see me. Was…
But can you remember anything about this period, as I say, like the last three months of his life, where you went and stuff
